title: Prop 15.135: coherent-mass spectral form on G; halfspace character sums; G·hs dead; moments don't pin δ; residual OPEN
settlement_note: No soft-close. Residual ⇔ ∑ c_j² ≤ room on ONB of E_{4p}^{G}. Halfspace f_hs Max+-free; G·hs incomplete and dead as UB; order-3 moments do not pin c_j. Full Gauss sum for m₄/c_j on Max+ still OPEN for general p. N_ED4_SUF OPEN. L OPEN.

spectral.theorem: δ=∑ c_j v_j on ONB of E_{4p}^{G}; δ²=∑ c_j²; c_j=E_y Q_j(y); residual ⇔ ∑c_j²≤room (≤ρ_min² for p≥7).

halfspace_char.theorem: f_hs(S) Max+-free via F_p indicators; ∑ f_hs = e₄ closed form (same as ∑ m₄ on Max+).

Ghs.theorem: O_hs=G·{±hs} ⊊ Max+; m₄^{Ghs}≠m₄; δ² from m₄^{Ghs} ≫ room (dead as residual UB).

moments.theorem: P_G(1)=P_G(κ)=0 on E_{4p}^{G} (cert p=5,7); e₄ and ⟨m₄,κ⟩ do not constrain the free c_j. Residual needs character sums for c_j.
moments.consequence: No Aut-line scalar reduction from order-3 moments alone

char_sum_program.theorem: c_j=N⁻¹∑_y Q_j(y); Q_j(hs) Max+-free if Q_j constant on Max+; constancy fails (p=5: four G-orbits of Max+ vectors). Need full Max+ character sums for m₄ on G-orbits of 4-sets.

char_sum_program.open: Gauss/character-sum formula for m₄(orbit) or for each c_j for general primes p≥5.
